title: SuperScale
description: superscale.com SuperScale is a Slovak game growth platform founded in 2015 in Bratislava, helping over 500 mobile game studios scale their games through AI-powered performance marketing, data science and monetization optimization. With around 60 employees and 1000 plus games grown, it offers both a SaaS platform and managed growth services acting as an outsourced UA and live ops team. Its core technology includes predictive LTV and retention models, automated user acquisition campaigns and AI creative production across Facebook, Google, TikTok and Apple Search Ads. Led by CEO Ivan Trancik, the company specializes in hybrid monetization strategies combining ads, in-app purchases and subscriptions for casual, midcore and hypercasual titles.
